title: bandolier config file (~/.config/bandolier/config.yml)
description: cli-spec.md §8. Lives on the INTERNAL disk so doctor/status can report "SSD not mounted". Every key is optional; a missing file is equivalent to an empty one.

ssd_root.description: Directory holding the project dirs, e.g. /Volumes/ssd/claude-projects. Defaults to <ssd_volume>/claude-projects. Overridden by $BANDOLIER_SSD_ROOT.

ssd_volume.description: Mount point of the SSD itself, e.g. /Volumes/ssd — what `eject` unmounts. Overridden by $BANDOLIER_SSD_VOLUME.

catalogue_path.description: Service catalogue location (§4.1). Unset falls back to $SSD_ROOT/services.yml, then the bundled default.

terminal.description: Terminal the APP uses for shell-open (app-spec.md §7, §12). Surfaced here so there is a single source; the CLI never spawns a terminal.
